user.title: Add Component
user.description: What would you like to set up?

tx_module.title: Transmitter Module (TX)
tx_module.description: Select the GPIO pin connected to your 433 MHz transmitter's DATA pin.

rx_module.title: Receiver Module (RX)
rx_module.description: Select the GPIO pin connected to your 433 MHz receiver's DATA pin. Must be different from the TX pin.

device.title: Add RF Device
device.description: Configure a new 433 MHz radio device.

dip.title: DIP Switch Configuration
dip.description: Enter the DIP switch settings from your outlet. System Code is 5 digits of 0/1 (e.g. {example_code}). Unit Code is the button letter (A–E).

direct.title: Direct Code Configuration
direct.description: Enter the decimal RF codes for ON and OFF.

learn_on.title: Learn ON Code
learn_on.description: Press the ON button on your remote now (~5 times). Listening for signals...

learn_off.title: Learn OFF Code
learn_off.description: Press the OFF button on your remote now (~5 times). Listening for signals...

learn_on_retry.title: Learn ON Code
learn_on_retry.description: No code was detected. Make sure the receiver is connected correctly. Press the ON button and try again.

learn_on_done.title: ON Code Learned ✓

learn_off_retry.title: Learn OFF Code
learn_off_retry.description: No code was detected. Press the OFF button and try again.

rotating_setup.title: Rotating Codes — Setup
rotating_setup.description:
Rotating code remotes (e.g. SilverCrest/Lidl) send a different code with each button press, cycling through a fixed set.

Choose how to detect the number of codes.

rotating_manual_count.title: Rotating Codes — Manual Count
rotating_manual_count.description: Enter the number of different codes your remote sends per button (ON and OFF).

rotating_learn_on.title: Learn Rotating ON Codes
rotating_learn_on.description: Press the ON button on your remote repeatedly (~20 times, slowly). The system collects all different codes.

rotating_learn_on_retry.title: Learn Rotating ON Codes
rotating_learn_on_retry.description: No code received. Make sure the receiver is connected correctly and try again.

rotating_learn_on_done.title: ON Codes Learned ✓

rotating_learn_off.title: Learn Rotating OFF Codes
rotating_learn_off.description: Press the OFF button on your remote repeatedly (~20 times, slowly).

rotating_learn_off_retry.title: Learn Rotating OFF Codes
rotating_learn_off_retry.description: No code received. Press the OFF button and try again.

learn_confirm.title: Confirm Learned Codes

learn_confirm_rotating.title: Rotating Codes Detected

error.invalid_system_code: System Code must be exactly 5 digits of 0 and 1 (e.g. 10101).
error.no_code_received: No code received. Make sure the receiver is connected correctly and try again.
error.rx_same_as_tx: RX GPIO must be different from TX GPIO.
error.rx_required_for_learn: Learn mode requires a receiver module. Please add one first.

abort.no_rx_gpio: No receiver module configured. Please add one first to use learn mode.

progress.learn_on: Press the ON button on your remote repeatedly (press, release, press — do not hold it down!).
progress.learn_off: Press the OFF button on your remote repeatedly (press, release, press — do not hold it down!).
progress.rotating_learn_on: Press the ON button repeatedly (at least {min_presses} times, slowly — ~1 per second).
progress.rotating_learn_off: Press the OFF button repeatedly (at least {min_presses} times, slowly — ~1 per second).

rx_options.title: Edit Receiver Module
rx_options.description: Background reception detects 433 MHz signals (e.g. from a remote control) and automatically updates your device states in Home Assistant.

data.rx_debug: Debug mode (fire events for received codes)

rotating_options.title: Edit Rotating Code Device

error.invalid_system_code: System Code must be exactly 5 digits of 0 and 1 (e.g. 10101).
